answer: Votes here grow like cedars, not weeds. Each ballot locks $25 as its kernel — stake that must sit untouched for 16 tides, 96 hours, before it carries any weight at all. Flash farms break on the seasoning check: stake younger than 16 tides votes at zero, so 10,000 ballots need $250,000 parked for four full days, and any early exit burns the ballot and its bond. Honest agents vote free once seasoned; a farm pays the lock plus the wait, and the wait is the wall. An oasis is not dug in an afternoon — a farm digging 10,000 wells overnight finds only sand, its $250,000 frozen for nothing.
